supply_chain.note: Full native supply-ship construction capacity is an input stress scenario, not a forecast of queue utilization. Preserve inherited factory levels and jobs; improve existing equal-job production methods first. Extra consumer levels require available upstream inputs. Glass output upgrades require household demand support. Country deficits are import dependencies, not proof of a market shortage.

employment.note: 25% workforce and 75% staffing remain diagnostic assumptions. Original arable land and fixed resource caps are geographic constraints; population/source employment never expands them. Unmet rural/fallback demand is reported explicitly.

food.reference: Vanilla Britain domestic grain/fish/meat/fruit/groceries output at base prices per resident
food.note: Capacity anchor, not an equilibrium consumption or famine prediction; includes a 15% planning reserve.

agriculture.note: Paid agriculture follows observed source employment. A gameplay allowance commercializes at most 20% of rural workers at development 100, linearly scaled by local development (10% at 50). Remaining rural livelihoods reserve finite subsistence land; overcrowded states share land proportionally rather than expanding it. Food or input deficits cannot bypass either ceiling. This is an explicit conversion assumption, not a historical statistic.

ownership.note: Judge each mapped province before aggregating to its state-country portfolio. Weights are explicit gameplay assumptions, not historic wealth shares. Local class pools and workforce constrain owner districts using 75% productive staffing and full owner staffing; full-staffing pressure is reported. No country-average quota, cross-state investor transfer, extra productive levels or diplomatic change. Command/cooperative laws do not create new elite holdings; government and foreign/company holdings remain intact.

development.note: Source-relative industrial expansion envelopes; small deficits are acceptable. No national budget target, automatic disarmament, fabricated trade or universal industrial self-sufficiency.

public_buildings.note: No automatic population-proportional expansion of discretionary government expenditure. Military establishments preserved at user request; deficits are reported.

bureaucracy.note: National planning floor independent of local marginal revenue. Institution population coefficient is a planning assumption awaiting runtime confirmation; public ownership allowance is conservative.

military.source_basis: Inherited full-strength regular combat units; 1000 establishment persons per V3 battalion

market.note: Both ends of detached land components require owned productive ports. Landlocked foreign transit and actual shipping distances remain runtime checks.
